notes: A5 flyer 148 x 210 mm, two sides (variants front and back), shown as MOCK-UPS on the slide 'Partner pakket' at a scale of 0.35807 (white sheets 53.173 x 75.194 mm). The mock-up is 148.5 mm wide at that scale (the standard A5 is 148 x 210, rounded from 148.5): the template and the reference viewBox use 148 x 210 as specified, so the reference cuts 0.5 mm off the right edge and the right hand elements sit 0.5 mm closer to the edge than in the mock-up. The mock-up shows no bleed, the template adds 3 mm. FRONT (voorkant): navy field 167.9 mm high, white footer; py-atom-logo-horizontal-white at scale 0.340 (overlap 0.99), photo placeholder = py-atom-shape-bubble-image-mask at scale 2.840 (the clip outline of the building photo, 102 x 124 mm; placeholder-photo with data-variable photo), py-comp-price-badge-circle placed 1:1 (white circle 56.0 mm, navy italic price '€7,50' and 'per dag'), py-comp-pill-location construction in white with navy pin and 'Hofplein' (the pill is 41.0 x 11.1 mm; own measures, see the comp note; the slide's one live text 'Hofplein' belongs to the raamsticker, on the flyer it is outlined like the rest), footer: py-atom-logo-beeldmerk-color at scale 0.452 (overlap 0.999), 'Parkeren en shopping' / 'maar dan voordelig' Ubuntu Bold 10.45 mm navy (leading 9.6 mm) and the small line in aqua Ubuntu Regular 4.13 mm. BACK (achterkant): white sheet, py-atom-logo-horizontal-color at scale 0.442 (overlap 0.97; the print logo has a navy dot where the library colour logo has the aqua dot, so the dot is recoloured to navy, a one colour navy logo that the library does not have), large photo bubble placeholder (py-atom-shape-bubble-image-mask at scale 3.038, overlap 1.00), 'Makkelijk parkeren' / 'vanuit je broekzak' Ubuntu Bold 9.86 mm navy (pitch 9.2 mm), 'Download nu onze app' Ubuntu Regular 7.87 mm navy, QR plate 30.6 mm. QR: the source draws a real QR code (white modules on a navy rounded square, vector paths, 1193 sub paths); the reference keeps it, the template has the plate and a placeholder group qr-target (data-variable qr-target, example https://parkingyou.nl/nl). The library plate py-comp-qr-plate does NOT match: corner radius 3.85 mm on 30.6 mm (12.6 percent) against 5.77 on 87.9 (6.6 percent), the other plate py-comp-qr-reserveer is 10 percent: the plate is drawn inline (owner: add a plate variant with 12.6 percent?). Texts are outlined in the source and live Ubuntu in the template, fitted by overlay (IoU 0.86 to 0.99). Colours: slide blue #192AA2 is drift (template #1A3580), slide cyan #0AD3E6 (small line, beeldmerk dot) is not PY-Aqua; the template uses the token #32B9CD. Variables front: price, price-cents, unit, location-name, claim-1, claim-2, validity, photo, background-colour; back: headline-1, headline-2, subline, photo, qr-target. Open points: the building photo (Hofplein) and the hands photo are placeholders; the price 7,50 per dag appears here and on the Hofplein panel.
